text:
maria: pushed a tiny refactor to normalize symbol casing in runtime; split into two commits (naming + fmt). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4829 — can someone quick-review + help with CI if it flakes?

alex: looking now. CI failed the formatter step and linter has a few initialism nits (ID vs Id) in the exposed structs.

kevin: I can pick the naming nits. For format I usually run `make format` locally and push. Is this one safe to autoapply?

maria: yes, `make format` fixes most of it. I already ran it once and pushed, but Buildkite still complained about a file under `pkg/gen`. Not sure why.

sam: quick heads-up — our format check excludes generated files under `pkg/gen/` in presubmit, but that rule only excludes the *check*, not the formatter step that updates files. CI shows "file changed by format" so presubmit aborted. Running `make format` and committing should clear it.

alex: small nit on naming: team style says initialisms uppercase (e.g., `userID`, `sessionID`). PR currently has mixed `userId` in the public proto/JSON tags. Can we standardize to `userID`?

kevin: agreed. I can make a follow-on commit that replaces `userId` -> `userID` in the changed files only. Want to avoid wide repo churn.

maria: that would be perfect — please limit it to files touched by this PR. If needed I can rebase/squash after.

kevin: will do. Plan: fetch branch, apply `git apply` patch with the renames, run `make format`, push. Example commands:

```
git checkout -b fix/id-initialism
git fetch origin refs/pull/4829/head:pr-4829
git checkout pr-4829
# sed script that targets changed files only
sed -i 's/userId/userID/g' $(git diff --name-only origin/main...HEAD)
make format
git add -A && git commit -m "style: use ID initialism in changed files"
git push origin HEAD
```

alex: thanks — if the sed touches unrelated files we should revert those. Keep the commit scope minimal.

maria: pushed another commit with `make format` after kevin's change, linking latest commit in PR.

format-bot: format step passed on commit 8f9a1c3 — buildkite/format ✓

alex: quick review: code looks fine, naming nit fixed in the new commit. One tiny docstring tweak but not blocking. Approving now. :thumbsup:

kevin: approved. I'll wait for full CI then merge.

sam: I'll watch CI and merge on green. Also added a short note in the PR description about the initialism change for changelog clarity. :memo:

maria: awesome, thanks all. If CI flakes ping me and I'll re-run the format locally and push.

kevin: merging in ~10m once pipeline completes.

sam: merged after CI green. Closing. :tada:
